releases.notes:
# CobbleSafari 0.3.0

## Major features

### Rotom Phone
A fully functional Rotom Phone, inspired by the mainline games. You can obtain one by crafting an empty phone and by letting a Rotom from your party move into it (Rotom, on top of spawning in the Safari, can now also spawn near placed Empty Phones !). Phones made using a shiny Rotom will also be shiny, and keep a disctinc look from regular non-shiny rotom-phones (even with skins). If Accesories is installed, a dedicated slot is added to have your rotom-phone fly next to you. 

The Rotom-Phone has many features:
- **Messaging App (Quests)** : an app where you recieved messages from NPCs that gives you task and reward your efforts by unlocking more features for your phone or by giving you rewards. Tthe quests are used to unlock and explain the mod's mechanics, with multi-step storylines and daily repeatable timed quests. The system is fully datapackable, and can uses item-based gathering requirements, advancement-based requirements and statistics increments-based requirements.
- **GTS App** : an app that implement a system similar to the mainline game GTS. Each player can deposit a fixed number of pokemon on the database (which can be temporarily increase by using a GTS Ticket), and ask for a specific pokemon in exchange (species, form, gender, level range, shiny status). Player are also able to browse and filter everyone else's offers, and complete trades asynchronously. Also supports unique trades, which are datapack-defined trades that can be added via admin commands, and personal trades, trades only visible to a specific player, used either as quest reward or given via admin commands, to give relevance to the app even in singleplayer.
- **Wonder Trade App** : an app that implement a system similar to the mainline game, designed with both singleplayer and multiplayer in mind. Up to 3 times a day (or more if you uses a Wonder Trade Ticket), a player can choose to send a party Pokémon into the wonder trade pool and get sent a random one back. Supports a complete range of custom parameters to populate the pool (in order to make legendary/mythicals less common than the "random" command), including support for limited-time events where the pool increase the appearance rate of certains species. Pokémon pulled from the pool roll a random cosmetic form when one exists (patterned Vivillon and Alcremie, lettered Unown, tree-wearing Torterra, Magikarp Jump patterns, dyed Wooloo, and so on).
- **Union Room App** : an app that let you join an union room, inspired by generation 3/4/5's Union Rooms. From from almost anywhere, create a private lobby or join a friend's with a 4-letter code and get teleported into a private, pocket dimension. Here you're free to battle, trade and spend time as you want. Instances are reusable and come in two sizes: the small **Union Room**, and the larger **Union Plaza** with its own player capacity and instance count, chosen at creation. A 60-minute session timer and an exit teleporter put you back exactly where you left off before joining.
- **Holo-Skin App** : an app that let you change you rotom-phone appearance by applying an holographic skin over it ! Skin change both the phone's GUI and its model, so you can show of your favorite Holo-Skin when equiping the phone ! Some skin even comes with custom wallpaper for the interface. Skins can be unlocked via quest rewards, advancements, or by finding rare items; and the system is datapackable so server owners and modpck creators can add as many skins as they want.
- **Safety Settings App** : Similar to Scarlet&Violet and Legends Z-A, your Rotom-Phone includes two safety features, toggleable at wish : **Roto-Fall**, which cushions long falls to avoid fall damage, and **Roto-Glide**, a second jump that reaches twice the normal jump height but can only be triggered during large jump.

The Rotom-Phone is completely configurable for server owners and modpack makers :

releases.notes:
## Major features :

### Underground Dungeon rework
 1. Added more traders types (traps, donut, hex maniac)
 2. Rebalanced ALL hiker trades to have a strict economy, based on math and drop rates. 

### Distortion Dungeon rework 
1. Reworked the Distortion world generation, added new structure segments.
2. Added the Giratina's Shadow Boss in the Arena.
3. Added the Red Chain fragment Core, and the Red Chain. Use the Red Chain to throw a projectile thay, when it touches a living entity, freeze it for 5 seconds; pokemon are instead frozen for 15 seconds and allows a guaranteed capture.

### Safari rework
1. Reworked ghost, dark, psychic, fighting, water, fire, dragon, ground, steel and poison biomes, by adding a large range of new decorative and functioning blocks.
2. Added compacted trash to the Steel biome, which has a 10% chance of dropping Tinkagears, which are used to craft some of the mod's items. 

### Rotom Phone
A fully-fonctional rotom-phone with several usefull features :
   1. A quest system, available trough a chatting app : fully datapackable, used to explain the mod's mechanics.
   2. Wonder Trade : a serverside database that auto-fills itselfs to allows for offline wonder trade. Support custom parameters to populate the wonder trade and limited-time events.
   3. GTS : a serverside database to allows players to put up trade offers and complete trade online. Also support unique trades, which are datapack-defined trades, and personal trades, trades only visible to a specific player, used either as quest reward or given via admin commands. 
   4. Union Room : a system that allows players to create private lobbies to battle, trade and spend time in a pocket dimension, from almost anywhere. A good alternative to /tp commands, that directly put the player back where they left off before joining.
   5. Rotom Phone Cosmetics : allows players to change the look of their phone

### CSBoss System
A custom system that let admins create boss fight where the goal is to survive waves of attacks from a boss. Complete documentation will be available on the final release. 
### CSMusic System
A custom system that let admins create audio soundscapes for specific event (for now, only csboss battles), dimension or areas. Complete documentation will be available on the final release. 
 

### Dimensional Objectives System
A Syetm that allows to add instanciated objectives per dungeon instance or per dimension. For players, it adds quests to dungeon existing dungeons. For Admins, allows to add daily quests to dimensions or their custom dungeons.  Complete documentation will be available on the final release. 
 

## Fixes and small features :
- Add config to add new dimensions where hoopa portals can spawn :ok:
- Add config to blacklist blocks where portals cannot spawn on top of :ok:
- Add config to change cooldown of girztina core :ok:
- made it so all red crystal can stack up to 16. :ok:
- Fix PC Block not using battery when activated for less than a tick  :ok:
- Fix Tumbleston being able to be placed in the underground & others restricted dimensions. :ok:
- Fix GTS confirm screen (with the rotating arrows), need to push up pokemon inside its shown area :ok:
- Fix Online pc model: switch the north/south and west/east hitbox/selection box for :ok:
- fix issue with restriction config being reset at every reload/launch :ok:
- fixed the portal cleanup method to avoid forceloading of chuncks and added a fallback in case the system clean doesn't happens.
- snorlax texture can be hidden from the timer :ok:
- fixed empty hole when a secret base cannot spawn. :ok:
- fixed a misleading message appearing when the shiny reroll crystal did not roll a shiny (message made it looks like it was a bug); now particles appears over the pokemon when usage happend but doesn't roll on shiny. :ok:
- Fixed an issue that, when under heavy server load, would cause a crash when deleting a dungeon. :ok:
